incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate + packet drops observed for Redwood Private interconnects terminating in GCP europe-west6 (Zurich). Metric spike started ~2026-03-15T14:26:30Z. Affected: 3 private customers using Interconnect + Cloud Router. Auto-remediation did not trigger. Paging SRE.
Maya R: @Eli (oncall) you on the hook? Looks like BGP flaps and DNS resolution failures for routes that prefer the interconnect.
Eli (oncall): I’m up. Acknowledging. Pulling BGP adjacency and router logs now. Can @Infra Team grab the Cloud Router control plane logs and any recent config changes from the change window?
Jordan P: I see corresponding TCP retransmits at the edge (observability). We have increased tail latency for private endpoint calls and a handful of 502s from customers behind the interconnects.
Alex K: Escalating to SEV-2 until we have containment. Customer-impact: degraded service for private-connected workloads (no public API failure). Customer-success please prepare a short note to the three affected accounts.
Customer Success: On it — drafting a message. ETA 10m.
Infra Team: pulling router status now. Running:
```
# get BG P status for the affected router
gcloud compute routers get-status redwood-eu-router --region=europe-west6
# list advertised and learned routes
gcloud compute routes list --filter="network:redwood-private AND region:europe-west6"
```
Infra Team: output (trimmed):
```
BGP peer: peer-ic-1  state: ESTABLISHED -> DROPPED (15:23:xx)
Learned routes: 0 (was 24)
Notice: suppressing route advertisements to expander clusters
```
Eli (oncall): That suggests a control-plane instability causing learned routes to vanish -> traffic fallback to default next-hops and DNS resolution occasionally hitting wrong egress path. Quick mitigation options:
- Re-advertise critical prefixes from customer CE (if they can) / ask carrier
- Move traffic off europe-west6 to fallback region (europe-west2) via smart routing policy for affected customers
- Temporary prefix-level static routes in customer VPCs to prefer Interconnect if the learned routes are present
Jordan P: We can flip smart-routing at the edge for those customers. Rolling change: route preference + weight to push traffic to europe-west2 for ~30m while GCP investigates.
Maya R: Who can push the smart-routing change? @Eli or @Jordan?
Eli (oncall): I can push the routing override for two affected customers now, need confirmation for the third (it’s on a custom config). Will do one-by-one and monitor. I’ll update when done.
incident-bot: page @Eli (oncall) and @Infra Team — incident timeline created: https://redwood.example/incident/2140005678
Alex K: Also ping GCP support — region-wide control plane looks problematic. Ticket opened P1: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/12345 (ref 6789). Contact assigned: GCP-NOC.
Infra Team: GCP response: "We've observed router control-plane reconvergence in europe-west6, investigating prefix suppression due to an internal routing flap." — continuing to work with us.
Customer Success: Draft sent to customers, holding until we have confirmed containment steps. Template: one-line symptom + we're routing to fallback region + estimated time to recover.
Jordan P: Routing override applied to cust-A and cust-B. Monitoring shows dropped packets down ~80% after routing change. Latency for those customers down to normal for most calls.
Eli (oncall): Still waiting on cust-C routing config details. Reaching out to SEs on their account now. Meanwhile enabling additional cache TTLs in the edge proxy to reduce DNS dependency for failing lookups.
Maya R: Good containment. Please add timeline entries: detection 14:26Z, paging 14:27Z, mitigation rollout 14:34Z, drop in errors 14:42Z.
Alex K: Prepare post-incident blameless notes: runbook gaps include missing auto-reconfigure for fallback regions and no throttled re-advertise attempt. Add action item to add a canary that simulates learned-route loss.
Eli (oncall): Handoff: I’ll be on-call for the next 1h while GCP continues RCA. @Maya R please take next 2hr watch if anything persists. If error rates creep back above threshold alert and we’ll reroute fully to backup region.
incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handover recorded. Next reminder in 30m.
Jordan P: Logging snippets for incident channel (for postmortem):
```
2026-03-15T14:26:32Z router-peer peer-ic-1: BGP: neighbor 10.1.1.2 went from ESTABLISHED to IDLE
2026-03-15T14:28:10Z proxy edge: dns lookup failed for internal-host -> rc=-3 (SERVFAIL)
2026-03-15T14:34:50Z routing: smart-route override applied for cust-A -> preferred europe-west2
```
Customer Success: Sent interim update to customers at 14:45Z. Will send follow-up once GCP confirms fix or at 17:00Z if unresolved.
Maya R: Thanks team. Keep updates compact here. Add any postmortem action items as separate thread under /eng-postmortems.
Eli (oncall): Will follow up with a short incident summary after GCP confirms fix. If routes fully re-learn and stability held for 45m, we can close the incident.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> partial. Impact: Private interconnect customers degraded -> now limited to 1 customer with intermittent issues. Severity: SEV-2 -> monitoring.
